findings.lineage: The D-351/D-352 successor sweep is internally contradictory and under-swept.

Six leaves still name leftover-join.v25 of G21 (D-349) as the current recorded G21 leftover remasurement, even though D-351 recorded leftover-join.v28 of G21 and D-352 expressly preserves v28 as current. registerRowNote first calls v28/D-351 current and then calls the same frozen v28 'unrecorded.' authorityClaim says the live D-352 remeasurement is 'after g21-fixture-corpus.v25 (D-350)' rather than after the new g21-fixture-corpus.v26/D-352 authoring act named by purpose and registerRowNote.
findings.evidence: The stale v25-current claims occur in basedOn.predecessorV20.role, predecessorV17.role, predecessorV14.role, predecessorV13.role, findingDisposition.claudeV21M4, and findingDisposition.claudeV26M1. The two finding dispositions also falsely describe the current remeasurementClause, which in fact names v28/D-351 and guards v28 plus g21-fixture-corpus.v26. In registerRowNote, 'leftover-join.v28 of G21 (D-351) remains the current recorded' and 'Frozen leftover-join.v28 of G21 stays unrecorded' occur in the same string. Live COORD D-351 records v28; D-352 says v28 remains the current recorded G21 leftover remasurement.
findings.why: Current-remasurement custody identifies the frozen predecessor this successor can replace and the bytes whose motion invalidates recording. The prompt expressly attacks any surviving v25-current claim. Calling recorded v28 unrecorded and anchoring the authority sentence to the superseded D-350 corpus also make the candidate disagree with its own purpose, predecessorV28 role, remeasurementClause, and live D-351/D-352 authority.
findings.requiredCorrection: Advance every present-tense current-remasurement recital and finding disposition to frozen leftover-join.v28 of G21 at D-351. Remove the false v28-unrecorded sentence and preserve the rule that v28 is current only until a recordable successor is adopted. Make authorityClaim identify g21-fixture-corpus.v26/D-352 as the new authoring act whose leftover-design status v29 remasures, while preserving g21-fixture-corpus.v25/D-350 only as historical input and without remasuring either corpus artifact.
